meaning:
scales, balances
Aramaic equivalent: mo.zen (מֹאזֵנְיָא "scale" H3977)

elsewhere.note: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
“Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measuring basket, and…
I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.
“You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then…
A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
